newsitem.title: USA: SigmaTron shares drop, analyst knows of no reason.
newsitem.headline: SigmaTron shares drop, analyst knows of no reason.

text.p: SigmaTron International Inc shares were off eight at 15-1/4 on Monday afternoon, but an analyst said he knew of no fundamental reason for the decline.

"There's no reason to believe there is any big problem at the company," Southeast Research analyst H. Hickman "Hank" Powell said. Powell said he spoke with officials of the company, which also did not have a reason for the decline.
"The company has not indicated any reason for the sudden drop," Powell said.
The company, which makes electronic components and printed circuit board assemblies, could not be reached for comment.
Sigmatron is expected to release fiscal third-quarter earnings next week, the analyst said.
Powell estimates third-quarter earnings of about $0.30 a share on revenues of $23 million, up from year-ago earnings of $0.26 a share on sales of $20 million.
The analyst said the third-quarter results were expected to be lower than results reported for the second quarter ended October 31, when the company earned $0.45 a share on sales of $29.7 million.

Powell said the company's second-quarter performance benefited a contract to make Nighthawk Systems' carbon monoxide detection products. Sales of those products tend to be stronger in the winter months, he said.
